title: Breaking Barriers to Reproducibility
subtitle: An interview for the University of Sussex's research culture impact cases, following the Openness in Research Award.
summary: Dr Dominique Makowski is featured in the University of Sussex's research culture impact cases, talking about open science, the software that makes it easier, and what still stands in its way.
content: Following the Openness in Research Award, Dr Dominique Makowski is featured in the University of Sussex's Our research integrity series, in a piece written by Alice Sambrook.

The interview covers what pulled the lab towards open research in the first place, the reproducibility crisis in psychology, the software built to make transparent work easier (easystats and NeuroKit), and the two things that still keep researchers from working openly: the fear of being scooped, and imposter syndrome. Read it on the Sussex site.
